description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for git fetch/push functionality over HTTP, including setup of server and client repositories, and verification of object counts during push operations.

methods.name: grep_wrote
methods.description: A helper function to count and verify the number of objects written during push operations by grepping the output log.

methods.name: setup_client_and_server
methods.description: Sets up a client and server git repository, configures remote URLs, and pushes initial commits to prepare for testing push scenarios.
